semantics.how: Collects unclaimed modules under one static unit, returning null when there are none
semantics.what: Builds a structural container for modules no layer claimed
semantics.where: Interpreter: pass orchestration and snapshot assembly
semantics.why: Gives orphan modules a parent without inventing meaning

semantics.how: Splits sorted paths into segments and prints each new directory and file at its depth
semantics.what: Renders file paths as an indented directory tree
semantics.where: Interpreter: pass orchestration and snapshot assembly
semantics.why: Shows clustering and naming prompts the repo layout

semantics.how: Collects call edges with branch labels, the DI dependency map, eligible flow units and route hints

semantics.when: Shared by runFlowsPass and the agent-authored flow merge
semantics.where: Interpreter: pass orchestration and snapshot assembly
semantics.why: Both paths must trace identical steps

semantics.how: Maps call evidence lines to the caller's control-flow edges and returns a true, false or exception style label
semantics.what: Derives a branch label for a call from its evidence
semantics.where: Interpreter: pass orchestration and snapshot assembly
semantics.why: Carries branch meaning into flow steps

semantics.how: Sets id, route, steps, branching steps and narration fields and computes hashes

semantics.where: Interpreter: pass orchestration and snapshot assembly
semantics.why: One builder regardless of who wrote the narration

semantics.how: Reparents modules under layers and layers under groups, rolls up layer edges, adds the system and container units and attaches flows and blocks
semantics.what: Merges pass outputs into one scv snapshot
semantics.when: Called at the end of analyze and runInterpreter
semantics.where: Interpreter: pass orchestration and snapshot assembly
semantics.why: Single assembly point for the final snapshot shape

semantics.how: Rounds to seconds and renders as 1m42s or 8s
semantics.what: Formats elapsed milliseconds as minutes and seconds
semantics.when: Used in progress lines and run summaries
semantics.where: Interpreter: pass orchestration and snapshot assembly
semantics.why: Keeps time formatting consistent

semantics.how: Renders extract purposes, modules and notes followed by the tree, returning undefined when empty

semantics.when: Passed to cluster and group prompts
semantics.where: Interpreter: pass orchestration and snapshot assembly
semantics.why: Gives narration passes repo-level evidence

semantics.how: Returns a short hash of the JSON serialisation or null when semantics are missing
semantics.what: Hashes a unit's semantics object
semantics.where: Interpreter: pass orchestration and snapshot assembly
semantics.why: Lets the differ detect meaning changes

semantics.how: Checks the unit's file against generated path rules

semantics.when: Used to exclude units from clustering
semantics.where: Interpreter: pass orchestration and snapshot assembly
semantics.why: Generated imports describe the generator, not the architecture

semantics.how: Checks the unit's test flag or test path
semantics.what: Tells whether a unit is test code
semantics.when: Used to skip narration of test code
semantics.where: Interpreter: pass orchestration and snapshot assembly
semantics.why: Test code keeps only structural fields

semantics.how: Filters out test and generated units, collects import edges between modules and runs Pass B clustering

semantics.where: Interpreter: pass orchestration and snapshot assembly
semantics.why: Deterministic Pass B with no provider call

semantics.how: Delegates to runPassDocs over the discovered doc files
semantics.what: Extracts structured information from repo docs
semantics.where: Interpreter: pass orchestration and snapshot assembly
semantics.why: Feeds repo context to later passes

semantics.how: Asks for entry point proposals, traces each with traceFlowSteps and narrates the steps with narrateFlow

semantics.why: Describes request paths through the system

semantics.how: Orders units bottom-up by calls, reuses cached results by struct hash, calls Pass A with callee one-liners and labels each function's control-flow blocks

semantics.where: Interpreter: pass orchestration and snapshot assembly

semantics.how: Runs Pass C groups, resolves membership to layer ids and builds the group units and reparenting map

semantics.why: Adds the architecture level above layers

semantics.how: Checks every in-set dependency is in the finished set
semantics.what: Tells whether an id's dependencies have all finished
semantics.where: Interpreter: pass orchestration and snapshot assembly
semantics.why: Gates dispatch on dependency completion

semantics.how: Runs functions, clusters, narration, groups and flows passes then finalizes the snapshot

semantics.how: Derives the id from the snapshot repo or given system name

semantics.where: Interpreter: pass orchestration and snapshot assembly
